module.Chapter: Chapter 5 · Functions, Files, and Raspberry Pi
module.Title: Review Historical Data
module.Teaching: Read mode loads existing file contents. The with statement closes the file automatically afterward.
module.ExampleCode:
with open("events.txt", "r") as file:
    history = file.read()
module.TargetCode:
with open("readings.txt", "r") as file:
    history = file.read()
    print(history)
module.FillStarter:
with open("readings.txt", "___") as file:
    history = file.___()
    print(history)
module.PredictionQuestion: Which mode opens a file for reading?
module.PredictionExplanation: The r mode opens an existing file for reading.
module.BrokenCode:
with open("readings.txt", "a") as file:
    history = file.write()
print(history)
module.DebugPrompt: Use read mode, call read(), and keep operations that use the open file inside the block.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the historical-data reader. Use these exact identifiers: file, history, open, print, read. Use the exact value "readings.txt".
module.TransferPrompt: Read and display events.txt. Use these exact identifiers: file, open, print, read. Use the exact value "r".
module.TransferCode:
with open("events.txt", "r") as file:
    events = file.read()
    print(events)
module.PreviewMessage: Operators can now review previous facility events.
